name: Humid Warm Monsoon
description: Persistent canopy humidity (>85%) and temperature 24-28C creating optimum spore germination.

name: Cool Moist Overcast
description: Prolonged leaf wetness and cool temperatures triggering devastating oomycete infection.

name: Hot Dry Summer
description: Arid conditions reducing fungal foliar sporulation but escalating whitefly and pest vectors.

name: Temperate Moderate
description: Favorable conditions for healthy vegetative growth and flowering with minimal pathogen pressure.
